overlay.name: Overlays
overlay.description: Dialogs, panels, and hints that appear over the current screen.

feedback.name: Notifications and feedback
feedback.description: Messages that report results and errors.

navigation.name: Navigation
navigation.description: Paths that show where you are and lead to other pages.

disclosure.name: Disclosure
disclosure.description: Long content split up so people open only what they need.

text-input.name: Text input
text-input.description: Fields where people type letters and numbers.

selection.name: Selection controls
selection.description: Controls that turn things on and off or pick one option.

special-input.name: Special input
special-input.description: Inputs with a fixed format, such as dates, files, and colors.

button.name: Buttons and states
button.description: Things you can press, and the states they go through.

list-table.name: Lists and tables
list-table.description: Screens that line up many items and compare them.

card-gallery.name: Cards and galleries
card-gallery.description: Screens that show images and summaries as cards.

indicator.name: Indicators
indicator.description: Small marks that show a state or a count.

layout.name: Layout
layout.description: Ways to divide the screen and keep parts of it in place.

loading.name: Loading
loading.description: What to show while people wait.

gesture.name: Gestures
gesture.description: Swipes, presses, and other finger movements.

data-viz.name: Data visualization
data-viz.description: UI that shows differences, changes, and shares in numbers.

empty-error.name: Empty states and errors
empty-error.description: What to show when there is nothing to show or loading failed.

onboarding.name: First run
onboarding.description: Screens that help newcomers find their way.

completion.name: Completion and rewards
completion.description: Screens that give a sense of having finished.

reaction-share.name: Reactions and sharing
reaction-share.description: Screens for rating, spreading, and working together.

ai.name: AI screens

pricing-display.name: Prices and discounts

search-discovery.name: Search and discovery

auth.name: Sign-up and sign-in

dark-patterns.description: Screens that trick people into choices they did not want.

pricing-psychology.name: Pricing psychology

icon-names.name: Icon names
icon-names.description: Icons whose shape you know but whose name you forget.

ux-research.name: UX research
ux-research.description: Observation and evidence for answering questions about a product.

ui-comparison.name: UI comparisons
ui-comparison.description: Look-alike UI side by side in the same situation, compared by purpose and behavior.
